description: Source code for Azure Prompt Shield Guardrail integration in LiteLLM, implementing pre- and post-call hooks to scan prompts and responses for policy violations using Azure's API.

classes.name: AzureContentSafetyPromptShieldGuardrail
classes.description: Implements a guardrail for Azure Content Safety using Prompt Shield API, with methods for request handling and prompt response scanning.

methods.name: async_make_request
methods.description: Sends a prompt to Azure Prompt Shield API and returns the response.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-processing hook to scan user prompts before sending to LLM, raising HTTPException if attack detected.

methods.name: async_post_call_hook
methods.description: Post-processing hook to scan LLM responses before returning, raising HTTPException if response is malicious.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for the guardrail.
